connector.name: Unlinked
connector.registryDescription: MCP server that brings your LinkedIn professional profile and experience into your context.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package unlinked. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the larsbaunwall account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: LINKEDIN_TOKEN
env.description: LinkedIn access token from the OAuth Token Generator. Accepts a bare token or 'Bearer <token>'. Required for EEA/Switzerland members only.

env.name: LINKEDIN_API_VERSION
env.description: LinkedIn API version in YYYYMM format (e.g. 202312). Defaults to 202312 when unset.
